hero.heading: Back Treatments
hero.lead: Think of it as a facial for your back. Deep cleansing and exfoliation for hard-to-reach skin, finished with warm stones that melt tension away.

items.text: Great for back breakouts, dry patches, and anyone who carries stress in their shoulders.
Wear something easy to change out of. You'll be comfortably draped the whole time.
Event-ready skin: popular before weddings and open-back outfits, book 1–2 weeks ahead.
Pairs well with a mini facial if you'd like a full reset in one visit.

steps.title: Cleanse
steps.body: A thorough double cleanse for skin you can't easily reach yourself.

steps.title: Exfoliate and treat
steps.body: Exfoliation and targeted care for congestion, dryness, or dullness.

steps.title: Mask and relax
steps.body: A customized mask does its work while you simply rest.

steps.title: Warm stones
steps.body: The Heated Stone treatment finishes with warm stone massage over the back and shoulders.
